description: Reformat a sci-fi novella manuscript for 6x9 inch paperback printing. Open /home/ga/Documents/crystal_crypt_draft.odt. Change the page size to 6.00" x 9.00". Set margins to Mirrored (Inner: 0.8", Outer: 0.5", Top/Bottom: 0.6"). Configure alternating headers: Left (Verso) pages should show the Page Number (Left aligned) and Book Title 'The Crystal Crypt' (Center aligned). Right (Recto) pages should show the Chapter Name field (Center aligned) and Page Number (Right aligned). Save the result as /home/ga/Documents/crystal_crypt_print_ready.odt.
